messages:
Lina Park: Heads-up: customers on the pilot want clearer upgrade guarantees for the on-prem packaging. They asked for a documented backout path when handing over VPC peering changes. Can we enumerate runbook steps and minimum telemetry?

Omar Ruiz: Key ask: end-to-end verification that peering preserves client source IP in their backend logs after handshake. If we break that, they're not shipping. Also need a config-seq number so we can track which handshake applied.

Tess Alvarez: Proposed quick list for staging acceptance: 1) two production-like canaries pass the connectivity sanity; 2) handshake applies with a recorded config sequence and auto-rollback if any health probe fails; 3) documentation published with SNAT behavior and exceptions.

Samir Patel: Perf note: we should classify kernels for our forwarding mode. eBPF path (kernel >=5.8) gets the fast path. Anything below gets iptables with noted perf penalty. Add that to the compatibility matrix.

Lina Park: Can we also include a customer-visible SLA tiering: "No interruption" vs "Short control-plane window"? And specify how long the advertised short window is (e.g., <=10m for this pilot).

Omar Ruiz: Adding test case: use `tcpdump -nn -i eth0` on customer's VM to assert original source IP. Include a validation harness in ci/e2e that can be run by SEs.

Tess Alvarez: I'll own the runbook and the post-install checklist. I'll include the rollback trigger thresholds: 5% error spike sustained for 3 min or control-plane health >30s degraded.

Samir Patel: I'll update the compatibility doc and add a perf curve chart for eBPF vs iptables. Also will note recommended default mode selection and fallback rules.

deploy-bot: Preview for branch `pkg/onprem/handshake` built: https://staging.redwood.dev/previews/onprem-2290 525 Tests: e2e queued.

Lina Park: Owners: Tess = runbook & docs; Omar = e2e harness + sample commands; Samir = compat matrix & perf. I'll collect the stakeholder brief and decide on go/no-go by next Friday.

Omar Ruiz: Will add harness snippet:
```
# preserved-ip assertion
ci/e2e --target-vm 10.8.0.5 --expect-src 10.8.0.5 --check-peering
```
Will also add the config-seq header to the agent handshake logs.

Tess Alvarez: Runbook ETA Thursday AM. I'll include checklist items and customer comms templates.

Samir Patel: Compat doc ETA Thursday EOD.

Lina Park: Thanks team. If we don't hit canary criteria we soft-launch with opt-in flag and extra monitoring. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
